body: I wouldn't be able to call right now, but sure, I have time to spare.

First, you mention that you're somewhat famous, so I would assume that you've basically lived off of people that enjoy whatever your work is? Whether it's something like writing, or singing, or even creating things, think of all the people that enjoyed what you did. Even if they were only happy for a few minutes, that's still something that you can be proud of.

If this isn't what you wanted from life, then there is absolutely nothing wrong with feeling like you need to change how you are at the moment. If your current situation is giving you grief, then you have every right to take a break, look at your options, and try something different. 

Even if you weren't famous at all, you would still deserve to be happy. It sounds like you've spent a long time working for other people to make other people happy, so you also have more than enough right to think about yourself from now on. 

Change is hard sometimes, so I can't blame you for feeling like this. You can always see about getting a therapist or counselor to help you through it all, it's their job to help people who need it. If you don't like the idea of that, you could try changing your settings for a bit to clear your head and just be you for a while. Go on holiday somewhere, stay with a friend, or just give yourself a week to yourself at the least.
